sections: What is Aniimo?

Aniimo is a free-to-play, open-world creature-catching RPG from Pawprint Studio. Players explore the continent of Idyll, catch creatures with Aniipods, and use Twine to become collected Aniimo for combat, puzzles and traversal. Official store information confirms single-player, online co-op, online PvP and cross-platform multiplayer, while detailed launch-version systems will be verified before they are treated as settled facts.

sections: Start with a task, not a letter grade

Write down the problem you want to solve: completing a particular encounter, surviving longer or improving an exploration route. A character that helps with one task may not help with another. Compare candidates within the same task before assigning an overall rank.
Build a shortlist from the catalogue

Filter the catalogue by element and role, then open the official Wiki record for each candidate. Treat these labels as a way to find options. A stage, element or role label alone does not establish damage, survivability, availability or investment cost.
Keep comparison conditions consistent

For a useful personal test, record the game version, platform, opponent, character level, upgrades, equipment and team members. Change one candidate at a time where possible. If investment differs, record that difference instead of presenting the result as a direct strength comparison.
Record more than a fastest run

Repeat the same task and note completion time, failures, recovery needs and ease of execution. Keep unsuccessful attempts in your notes. A single favorable result is not enough to establish a reliable recommendation; separate your observation from a general conclusion.
Compare the cost of switching

Before spending limited materials, check the requirements shown in your current game client and what you already own. A small improvement may not justify rebuilding a team. This is a decision checklist, not a claim that any named character needs a particular item or upgrade.
What a future ranking must show

A published ranking needs a defined activity, tested version, comparable investment, recorded observations and limitations. We have not completed that evidence set, so this page does not assign S/A/B grades or claim a best character. Use the linked guides below for the evidence currently available.
Use role-specific comparisons
DPS, BREAK, SUPPORT, HEAL and REGEN answer different needs. Compare candidates within the same job and encounter instead of compressing unlike roles into one score.
Version and evidence policy

Every future recommendation must name the client version and review date, separate official labels from Aniimo.GG testing, and warn when a balance update makes evidence stale. Community reports can suggest a test, but cannot become a rank without repeatable release-build evidence.

extraBody: Set up Pathfinding before a long trip

Community public-build 1.0 help records a Pathfinding tab in Aniimo Management. Assign eligible Aniimo to climb, swim and fly there, then check the displayed ability levels. These assignments deserve a separate check from combat slots and a creature's named Mobility skill; current client labels take priority.
Plan the next obstacle, not just travel speed

Aniimo.GG recommends reading the route in three parts: ground access, water crossing and height change. Test the required action near a safe return point before committing to a long crossing. Read the current stamina gauge and landing options; a combat role or winged appearance alone does not prove the movement you need.
Check the active form when traversal fails

The cited community help describes terrain actions using the currently twined Aniimo, an eligible Pathfinding assignment or the Pathfinder. Verify the active form and assignment, remaining stamina, terrain prompt and any local restriction. Some obstacles need an elemental interaction rather than another movement attempt. Practice the relevant in-game Course and retry from stable ground.
Keep route advice reproducible

Record client version, exact Aniimo form, equipped Pathfinding ability, terrain and the observed result. Official Steam material confirms Twine supports puzzles and environmental challenges, but does not establish every movement tier or distance. Third-party carrier lists can identify candidates; verify their current ability text before investing.
extraFaq: Where do I assign climbing, swimming and flying Aniimo?

Is a combat role enough to choose an exploration Aniimo?
No. Inspect its current Pathfinding and Mobility text and test the action required by your route.
What should I check if a traversal action fails?
Check the active form, exploration assignment, stamina, terrain prompt and local restrictions. An elemental obstacle may require a different interaction.

body: Start with the official client and the right server

Aniimo is live on PC, console and mobile. Download only through Aniimo or an official platform store. Official account guidance says progress is shared across platforms on the same server, while different servers keep separate data, so confirm the server name before investing time.
Finish the opening guidance before spending resources

Use the tutorial to learn catching, Twine, combat and traversal. Check subtitles, controls and audio first, then keep early materials until the live menus explain their use. Beta costs, routes and catch rates are historical evidence, not current instructions.
Unlock mail and gift-code access

Community-tested release instructions place Gift Code Redemption under Settings → Account. Rewards are delivered through in-game mail, which unlocks after progressing the Chasing the Clouds story. Codes are case-sensitive and may expire or hit a claim limit.
Watch the progression gates

Current official events use rank gates: Windchaser’s Departure opens at Student I, Glamour Star and Aniimo Discovery at Student II, Holo-Battle Interlink at Trailblazer I, and Egg Heist Chaos Mode at Tier IV Elite Egg Seeker. Use these as goals, not reasons to rush past the story.
Claim the official free launch rewards

The launch announcement lists a rare Prismana Aniimo choice at Grade I Wayfarer, Aniilog collection accessories, activity rewards including catching items, a limited egg for cumulative login days, four free outfits, pre-registration milestone rewards and cross-platform login rewards. Availability still depends on the live account and event rules.
Build a flexible first team

Do not copy a permanent tier list before learning roles, elements and the encounter. Keep damage, Break and sustain needs in mind, but delay expensive upgrades until the live team and progression systems are clear.
Use current guides for the next decision
Check the codes page for source-graded gift codes, the event calendar for deadlines, the catching guide for confirmed workflow, and the crossplay guide before changing device or server.

potential-personality.title: Aniimo Potential & Personality Guide: Appraisal and Safe Upgrades
potential-personality.description: Understand Aniimo Potential, appraisal, Capability Awakening and Personality with official launch facts, version-labelled client observations and safe upgrade checks.
body: Potential and Personality are separate

The version 1.0 public-build records describe Potential as attribute quality split into Innate and Acquired progress, while Personality is a separate set of traits. Do not treat a good personality as proof of high Potential, or an appraisal grade as a complete build verdict.
What the official launch letter confirms

Pawprint Studio says high-Potential 9/9 and 10/10 wild Aniimo became more common, a Sparkling Cube guarantees Perfect Potential, Capability caps unlock gradually with level and Resonance, sub-level-60 Capability Awakening can be reset with materials returned, and Capafruit transfers through inheritance. The letter does not publish a complete appraisal table or personality bonus list.
Appraise before committing scarce materials

A version 1.0 help-center record says appraisal reveals a caught Aniimo's Potential information. Compare the attributes used by the live skill kit, current role and intended team before investing; a single grade should not replace reading the full panel.
Innate and Acquired Potential

Community public-build records distinguish Innate Potential obtained with the individual from Acquired Potential added through Capability Awakening. Exact caps, costs and material bands are client observations unless the official site states them, so this guide deliberately avoids presenting competitor cost tables as permanent rules.
Personality is a separate decision

Version 1.0 community records say Personality does not change through levelling or evolution and can be changed with Psyche Fruit. Exact trait percentages, best-in-slot combinations and shop costs are not published on the official public site; verify the current Personality panel before spending.
A safe keep, train or replace workflow

First confirm species, form and current skills; then appraise Potential; next compare role-relevant attributes; check Personality separately; finally review existing investment and inheritance options. This is Aniimo.GG editorial guidance, not an official tier list.
Inheritance reduces replacement risk

The official launch letter confirms Capafruit effects transfer automatically during inheritance. Version 1.0 community help records also describe moving training progress between compatible Aniimo. Confirm both sides, compatibility and the current preview before accepting; do not assume Personality or every identity field transfers.
Evidence boundary

Official facts above come from Pawprint Studio's launch letter. Menu paths and Personality behavior are version-labelled community observations from the public 1.0 client. Disputed probabilities, fixed prices and universal best personalities are intentionally excluded.

faq: Is Personality the same as Potential?
No. Version 1.0 client records show them as separate systems: Potential concerns attribute progression, while Personality is a separate trait layer.
Does a high Potential grade guarantee the best Aniimo?
No. It is one input. Current skills, role, form, Personality and the content you play still matter.
Can Capability Awakening be reset?
The official launch letter says it can be reset below level 60 with training materials returned. Check the current client for the exact confirmation and any cost.
Does Sparkling Cube guarantee Perfect Potential?
Yes. Pawprint Studio's September 3 launch letter explicitly says Aniimo caught with a Sparkling Cube have guaranteed Perfect Potential.
Does Personality change when an Aniimo evolves?
Version 1.0 community records say no and point to Psyche Fruit as the change method. This is a client observation, not a permanent official-site rule.
What should I check before inheritance?
Review source, recipient, compatibility, previewed progress and returned materials in the current client. The official letter confirms Capafruit transfer, not every community-described field.

resonance-ascension.h1: Aniimo Resonance Star-Up and Ascension Guide
body: Resonance is separate from level and Potential

Version 1.0 help records place Resonance inside Aniimo Training. Star-Up adds staged attribute progress, while Ascension opens the next stage. Capability Awakening raises Acquired Potential separately; do not spend Star Dust as if it were a Resonance material.
What the official launch letter confirms

Pawprint Studio confirms training caps now unlock gradually with Aniimo level and Resonance star rank. The same letter confirms Capability Awakening below level 60 can be reset, but it does not publish a full Resonance stage table, fixed costs or universal farming route.
The version 1.0 menu workflow

Community records based on the 1.0 client describe a loop: open Aniimo Training → Resonance, use the regional Dewdrop Crystal shown for the current Star-Up, fill the stage, meet the displayed level requirement, then use the listed elemental or additional materials to Ascend. Treat the current preview as authoritative.
Material names have different jobs

The community record separates regional Dewdrop Crystals used for Star-Up from elemental materials used at Ascension. Star Dust, Star Sand and Starcryst Essence belong to Capability Awakening instead. Read the selected Aniimo's current material panel rather than assuming every family uses one identical route.
A safe upgrade order

Choose an Aniimo that is already part of the active plan, complete only the currently available fixed steps, reserve the materials shown for the next Ascension, and stop when a level or version gate appears. Do not drain a second team member to copy an unversioned endgame table.
How Resonance affects other progression

The official letter links Resonance star rank to gradually unlocked Capability caps. Community records also describe Resonance stage and star rank as part of compatible inheritance. This does not mean Resonance, Potential and level are the same system.
Farming evidence boundary

Version 1.0 guides point players toward Alpha encounters and challenge categories for relevant materials. Exact drop rates, daily limits, total stage costs and fastest routes are not published by the official site, so this page does not present them as permanent facts.
Before confirming Ascension

Check the Aniimo's level, current stars, named regional crystal, elemental material, any additional requirement and the previewed bonus. If any field differs from this guide, follow the live client and report the difference.

faq: What is Resonance in Aniimo?
It is a staged training system. Version 1.0 records describe Star-Up steps followed by Ascension into the next stage.
Is Resonance the same as Capability Awakening?
No. Resonance uses its own staged workflow, while Capability Awakening raises Acquired Potential with separate materials.
What materials does Resonance use?
Version 1.0 records describe regional Dewdrop Crystals for Star-Up and displayed elemental or additional materials for Ascension. Check the current Aniimo panel for exact names.
Does levelling automatically Ascend an Aniimo?
No. Community records say the level requirement only opens eligibility; you still confirm the displayed Ascension materials and action.
Can Resonance progress move through inheritance?
Version 1.0 community records say compatible inheritance can move Resonance stage and star rank. The official letter independently confirms Capafruit transfer, not every inheritance field.

research-aniilog.description: Aniilog Research, photo reporting and Idyll Ecological Investigation: compare permanent research with the official catch-based event, phase dates, exact forms and first-completion points.
body: Aniilog is more than a species list

The official Compendium confirms the current species, forms, roles, elements and family information. Version 1.0 client records add a separate Research layer inside Aniilog, where Field Notes and topics track what you have observed or completed.
What the official launch announcement confirms

Pawprint Studio says catching and collecting Aniimo advances Aniilog milestones that award exclusive Aniimo accessories. This confirms the collection-to-reward relationship, but the official public site does not publish every Research Point threshold, topic count or accessory-slot rule.
Open the entry and read the clue

Version 1.0 community records describe opening an Aniimo's Aniilog entry, selecting its Research or Field Notes area and reading each visible completion clue. Track the wording shown for the current form or family instead of following an unversioned checklist.
Research topics use different actions

Community public-build records show topic patterns such as using skills, observing behaviour, catching or defeating a target, obtaining a form, evolving, photographing and completing other named actions. The exact set varies, so one species' list must not be copied to every family.
Family and form boundaries matter

The 1.0 records indicate that some Research progress is shared within a family while certain observations remain tied to a form or displayed clue. Check which entry is selected before assuming a task completed on one form covers another.
A safe field workflow

Before leaving an Outpost, pin one or two incomplete clues; combine them with the current region, catching route or team; perform the exact named action; then reopen Aniilog and verify progress. This avoids grinding an action that the current topic does not count.
Research Points, crowns and appearance

Community guides describe Research Points feeding crown-style milestones and additional accessory capacity. Treat the current client display as authoritative: exact thresholds, maximum slots and reward contents are versioned client observations unless Pawprint Studio publishes them.
Keep Research separate from collection bookmarks

Aniimo.GG's local collection bookmark only saves a browser-side preference and does not change game progress. Official Aniilog Research, rewards and accessory slots exist in the game account and must be completed in the client.
Evidence boundary

Official facts are limited to the Compendium and launch announcement. Field Notes, topic patterns, shared progress and crown behaviour are labelled as version 1.0 community observations. No disputed shortcut, automation method or fixed completion time is presented as official.
Camera modes — version 1.0 community record

The September 17 camera help record distinguishes Creative Mode for free framing, Selfie Mode for the character and Follow Mode for moving shots. Its Edit Aniimo screen positions party companions; return to Snap Mode before shooting. Follow the current on-screen controls rather than assuming one platform's keybinding applies everywhere.
A research photo is not just a saved screenshot

The same record describes a camera indicator above a wild Aniimo performing a special behavior. Read the selected Field Note first, photograph the named subject and behavior through the in-game camera, then reopen Aniilog to check recognition. Aniimo.GG recommends changing one condition at a time if it does not count; a system screenshot or a decorative portrait alone does not establish completion.
Reporting and claiming are separate checks

The version 1.0 Aniilog record describes Research Console reporting at an Outpost for catch research. The October 1 illustrated community guide separately shows completed Topics claimed in Aniilog before checking family Crown and Appearance capacity. Inspect the relevant screen instead of treating a pending report, an unclaimed topic and a locked slot as one problem; no universal point threshold is inferred.
Album proof: preserve evidence, do not bypass protection

The October 1 third-party walkthrough reports that some Album photos serve as research proof. This is a community observation, not an independently verified rule for every image or platform. If deletion is unavailable, inspect the selected photo and research status, retain it while troubleshooting and use official support if unclear. Aniimo.GG does not recommend editing game files to force deletion.
Idyll Ecological Investigation is a catch event, not a photo report

The October 27 Part 2 update notice requires Student I and catching the forms on each phase's survey list. This limited event is separate from permanent Aniilog research and camera submissions. Read the current event list; this notice does not supply a complete target or spawn table.
Count first completions, not repeated catches

Each target awards survey points only on its first completion. The captured form must match the list. First-survey points are doubled for a target not yet recorded in your Index; this does not establish doubled item rewards, catch odds or points for every repeat.
A low-risk event checklist — editorial guidance

Open the event and verify the phase and server clock. Match the exact name and form; if numbers repeat, compare the region/group in the compendium. Check existing completion and in-game Index status before spending resources (this site's bookmarks do not change it), catch one eligible target, then inspect points and reward thresholds. If credit is missing, save the list, form, time, server and before/after points for support instead of repeating captures blindly.

level-titles-elite-training.description: Aniimo title and level-cap guide: official Part 2 Trailblazer II/III changes, post-60 Ascension, level-65 star-up boundaries and the Glynsera elective fix.
level-titles-elite-training.h1: Aniimo Pathfinder Level, Titles and Elite Training
body: Pathfinder Level and Aniimo level are different

Version 1.0 help records describe Safaris as Pathfinder experience. Raising Pathfinder Level unlocks abilities and raises the available Aniimo training ceiling, but each Aniimo still needs its own EXP or growth items.
Why a full experience bar can stop

Community public-build records say the current Pathfinder title sets a level cap. When the bar stops, more Safaris alone may not solve it: review the Character title panel and the next promotion requirements.
Elite Training is the promotion workflow

The version 1.0 client record places Elite Training alongside story progression. Its Core Courses contribute to title promotion eligibility, while optional paths track broader catching, exploration, combat and Homeland activity.
The safe promotion checklist

Open the current title details, confirm the required level, open Elite Training, finish and claim the required Core Course objectives, then take the available promotion assessment. Read every live requirement before following an old quiz or opponent list.
What official sources confirm

Pawprint Studio's live event notices use titles such as Student I, Student II and Trailblazer I as access requirements. The launch developer letter also says training caps unlock gradually. These official sources confirm title-based progression boundaries, not a complete permanent level table.
Safaris sources — version 1.0 record

Community help records name story or Log progress, Elite Training Core Courses, Daily Activity, new catches, reported research and area progress among Safari sources. Treat live reward previews as authoritative; fixed payout totals can be rebalanced.
Feature unlocks must be checked live

Community records associate titles with systems such as Homeland, Resonance, Held Items, Capability Awakening and multiplayer activities. Official event notices confirm some current access titles, but a complete unlock matrix is not published on the official public site.
Do not confuse one-time and recurring tasks

Elite Training courses are described as progression objectives, while Institute Guide Daily Activity is recurring. Check reset timers and claim states in the client instead of assuming every board refreshes daily.
Evidence boundary

Exact cap numbers, course totals, assessment answers, reward sums and fastest routes remain versioned third-party observations unless confirmed by Pawprint Studio. This guide provides a diagnostic and decision workflow rather than a permanent grind table.
A specific official fix: the 18-type Alpha / Omega elective

Checked October 24, 2026. The official rolling notice's October 10 entry reports a fix for the elective Defeat 18 types of Aniimo Alphas/Omegas and says to re-challenge Alpha Glynsera after the update for it to count correctly. This is a dated remedy for that objective, not an instruction to repeat every boss or a guarantee of automatic retrospective credit.
Retry with a before-and-after record — editorial workflow

Open the exact elective and record its counter, full wording and current client version. Apply the current official client resources before following the cited Glynsera rematch advice. After the fight, return to the same objective and compare the counter and claim state. The wording refers to types; do not assume 18 repeated wins satisfy it or that the rematch completes all remaining types.
Separate an elective counter from a promotion gate

The two community guides distinguish Core Courses and electives but do not agree on every course-count presentation. Do not import either total as a permanent rule. If the rematch counts but promotion remains locked, read the title panel's required level and Core Course conditions. If the exact counter still fails, report the quest, before/after screenshots, server, build and encounter time to official support rather than resetting progress or repeatedly farming the same target.
Part 2 opens new assessments, not an automatic level grant

The October 27 official notice says Dr. Lewis contacts Pathfinders at level 60 or above to open Trailblazer II, Trailblazer III and Badge Challenge assessments. Contact is not completion: check the live assessment and title panel rather than treating level 60 as an automatic unlock of every higher cap.
Whisperwake Elite Training has its own access condition

The new Chapter of Whisperwake requires the Trailblazer I title and progress in the Whisperwake Isles story. This chapter gate is separate from the later title promotions; the notice does not provide a universal course count, assessment answer key or complete list of required story steps.
A cap increase does not finish an Aniimo's Ascension

The official raising changes require an Ascension after an Aniimo reaches level 60 before further leveling, using an Evolution Item matching its main element. The same notice permits Stellar Tier 6 through Resonance Star Up at level 65. These are distinct checks; it does not say that raising your title automatically pays materials, fills EXP or changes species.
Diagnose the blocked bar before spending — editorial checklist

First identify whether the stopped bar belongs to the Pathfinder or one Aniimo. Check title and assessment completion, then the Aniimo's own level, Ascension prompt and material preview. At 65, inspect the separate Resonance screen if star-up is the goal. Record the displayed blocker and build before requesting support. Do not buy or farm a guessed item quantity from a version 1.0 table.

Alpha Glynsera. The October 10 entry advises challenging it again after the update for the affected 18-type elective to count correctly.
Does the Glynsera rematch automatically unlock my next title?
No such guarantee is stated. It targets an elective-count issue; check the live title and required Core Course conditions separately.
What are Safaris in Aniimo?
Version 1.0 help records describe Safaris as experience for Pathfinder Level, not direct EXP for one Aniimo.
Why has my Pathfinder Level stopped?
You may have reached the cap for the current title. Check the Character title panel and Elite Training promotion requirements.
Why has my Aniimo stopped levelling?
Its available training ceiling can depend on Pathfinder progression, while its own bar still needs Aniimo EXP. Check both limits.

No. The notice opens assessments through Dr. Lewis; Trailblazer II and III promotions and individual training conditions remain separate.

Why can an Aniimo still stop at 60 after promotion?
Check its Ascension prompt. The official notice requires Ascension with an Evolution Item of its main element before further leveling; verify exact live requirements.

No. The notice allows Stellar Tier 6 via Resonance Star Up at Aniimo level 65; Trailblazer III is a title promotion with stated level-cap changes.

inherit-training.description: Compare Aniimo Inherit with the announced Whirlbite reset: eligible Basic/Prismana individuals, refund effects, regional November 12–27 windows and confirmation risks.
evidence: The September developer letter says Capafruit effects now transfer automatically during inheritance, so changing which Aniimo you raise no longer requires the same investment again.
body: Whirlbite reset: announced, not independently tested

The November 9 official update preview lists Whirlbite Basic Form and Prismana Form obtained before this balance adjustment as eligible for a limited reset. It returns named resources and removes corresponding training; it is not Inherit, which moves a training profile to another individual. Later catches and other forms are not confirmed eligible by this wording.
Regional windows are not a promise of early access

The reset is listed for November 12–27 at 04:00 in each server offset shown below. These are different global moments. On November 12, maintenance is Europe 06:00–11:00 UTC+0, Americas 02:00–07:00 UTC-4 and Apac 14:00–19:00 UTC+8. The listed 04:00 reset start is before maintenance in Europe/Apac, but inside the Americas maintenance window. The notice does not resolve access before the update; maintenance can vary. Do not assume the reset menu is usable at the listed start or while login is unavailable.
Before accepting a reset — editorial checks

Record the exact individual, form and training panels, then compare eligibility and every refund in the current preview after the official update. Do not inherit, release or retrain merely to test qualification. Stop and ask support if the preview differs. The notice does not separately specify every Ascend, Held Item or skill investment, prior-Inherit interaction, menu path, use limit or reversal guarantee. No real reset was performed for this guide.
What Inherit is for

Inherit is a training-management tool for moving an invested profile onto a more suitable Aniimo instead of rebuilding it from zero. Official material confirms automatic Capafruit transfer. The broader workflow below comes from version-labelled public-build 1.0 interface records and should be rechecked after updates.
Identity and training are separate

Community public-build records show that both Aniimo remain in the Collection: the transfer changes their training profiles rather than consuming the source. Species, form, personality and other identity traits stay with each Aniimo; levels and named training progress move according to the preview.
Read the transfer direction before confirming

The recorded interface places the trained source on the left and the intended recipient on the right. Do not rely on memory or a guide screenshot: compare both names, levels, Resonance and Potential panels in the current confirmation screen before accepting.
Check eligibility before planning a transfer

Version 1.0 records normally limit Inherit to the same evolution family and may reject Aniimo assigned to combat or exploration formations. Basic Irisalis is reported as a source-side family exception. These are community-observed client rules, not permanent official guarantees.
What the versioned client record says moves

The public-build help record lists EXP and level, Resonance stage and star rank, Capability Awakening, Capafruit effects and other training progress as one package, with surplus training items returned. Exact fields, refund handling and eligibility should be confirmed in the live preview.
A safe six-step workflow

First compare the exact form, Innate Potential, personality and skill fit. Remove both Aniimo from active formations if required. Put the trained profile on the source side, select the intended recipient, read every before-and-after value, then review the displayed fee and confirm only when the direction is correct.
When Inherit is useful

Use it when a clearly better same-family recipient matches the role you need and the existing training investment is worth preserving. It is a safety net for roster upgrades, not evidence that every new copy deserves an immediate transfer.
What this guide does not freeze as fact

The current fee, every selection restriction and the Irisalis exception are client-version details. Aniimo.GG does not present a third-party screenshot, one account result or an old numeric cost as a permanent official rule; the current confirmation screen takes priority.

core-gameplay.description: A source-labelled Aniimo training guide covering levels, Potential, Capability Awakening, Resonance, inheritance, catching resources and community-verified details.
body: Catch with timing and tools

Official descriptions say players use Aniipods, set traps and time a catch. Which Aniimo appear can depend on environment, weather, phenomena and time of day; exact release rates and optimal tools still need testing.
Twine for combat, puzzles and movement

Twine lets a Pathfinder become a collected Aniimo and use its perspective and abilities. Official examples include solving puzzles, fighting, gliding, diving and burrowing rather than treating every Aniimo as only a battle unit.
Evolution and forms

Most Aniimo can evolve, and official index entries include different forms. Evolution conditions, form availability and stat changes should be checked against the public release before beta instructions are treated as final.
What the official launch changes confirm

The September 3 developer letter confirms that the carried-item rune system was removed, Star Dust output was increased, Capability Awakening below level 60 can be reset with materials returned, training caps unlock gradually, and Capafruit effects transfer through inheritance. These are current official boundaries, not Beta assumptions.
Public-build training loop — community verified

A version 1.0 guide based on the in-game help center reports a practical order: raise level, add Resonance with Dewdrop Crystals, use Star Dust for Acquired Potential through Capability Awakening, then match Held Items to the Aniimo's traits. Aniimo.GG labels these menu details community-verified because the official public website does not publish the complete training manual.
Potential and inheritance need careful wording

The same public-build record distinguishes Innate Potential from Acquired Potential and reports that inheritance moves level, Resonance and Capability progress from a developed Aniimo to a less-developed compatible one. The official developer letter independently confirms material-return and Capafruit-transfer improvements, but exact costs and every compatibility rule should still be checked in the current client.
A safer resource order

First keep a small playable team near your current progression cap; next fund the damage, BREAK and sustain roles you actually use; then invest scarce Potential or Held Item materials only after reading the live skill kit. This is Aniimo.GG editorial advice, not an official efficiency formula or tier list.
Confirmed resources and progression items

The developer letter also confirms legendary tokens from exploration and story progress for a personal Legendary Aniipod, plus Prismatic Energy, Prismana Flow, Legendary Star Dust, Capafruit, Sparkling Cubes, Aniimo eggs, furniture and formulas. These are confirmed systems or items, not a complete economy list.
What currency and cost information is not public

Pawprint Studio has not published a full currency catalogue, item prices, exchange rates, upgrade costs, drop amounts, shop stock limits, or a universal farming route. Community client records can explain menus, but should not be turned into permanent prices or drop rates without a version and repeatable evidence.
RV camps and Homeland

Each Pathfinder has a personal RV at an open-world campsite where players can meet. The launch letter confirms adjusted RV upgrade times, order refresh improvements, furniture resale at a discount through the Co-op Store, RV dispatches that can produce Prismana-trait eggs, seasonal furniture and formulas, and harvest sharing through social tilling. Exact costs and odds are not published.
NVIDIA ACE companion interactions are a post-launch update

Pawprint Studio announced a future NVIDIA ACE update for voice and natural-language conversations with Aniimo. Players will be able to chat with companions, teach them new skills, send them to gather resources and see dynamic emotional responses. The announcement does not promise these features for the September 16 launch build or confirm every language, platform or Aniimo.
What NVIDIA ACE does not confirm

This companion feature is separate from player voice chat, speech-to-text accessibility and cloud gaming. GeForce NOW support, offline processing, microphone privacy settings, supported languages and a release date remain unconfirmed.

faq: What should I upgrade first in Aniimo?

Keep a compact active team levelled first, then prioritize the damage, BREAK and sustain roles you actually use. Potential and Held Item investment should follow current skill text rather than a copied tier list.
Are Resonance and Potential the same system?
No. Public-build help records describe Resonance as a star-based progression track and Potential as Innate plus Acquired attribute growth through Capability Awakening.
Can I reset Capability Awakening?
The official launch letter says Capability Awakening below level 60 can be reset and the materials returned. Check the current client before confirming any cost or later-level rule.
What currencies are confirmed in Aniimo?
The official launch letter confirms several resources and progression items, but does not publish a complete currency catalogue or a general coin price list.
What resources can I get from exploration?
The launch letter says legendary tokens come through exploration and story progress, while lucky strikes can grant item rewards and raise area Prismatic Energy. Amounts and drop rates are not public.
Can I farm Home resources?
RV dispatches can have a chance to produce Prismana-trait eggs, and social tilling can earn a share of another Pathfinder's harvest. Rates, limits and requirements are unannounced.
Will Aniimo support voice conversations with creatures?
Pawprint Studio has announced voice and natural-language companion interactions powered by NVIDIA ACE for a post-launch update.
Does NVIDIA ACE mean Aniimo supports GeForce NOW?
No. NVIDIA ACE is an interaction technology announcement, not confirmation of cloud-streaming availability.

extraBody: Held Item structure — version 1.0 community record

The public-build help record says Held Items unlock at Student III and can include a base effect, a core skill and an advanced effect. Contracts and core skills

A safer Held Item decision order

Read the exact trigger and role fit first, equip the item on the intended active Aniimo, confirm whether it has a core skill and only then enhance or contract it. Do not upgrade by color alone, and treat the current client text as authoritative over this version 1.0 workflow.

How does a Held Item contract work?

Are Prismatic Stones the same as a contract?

The October 27 update notice announces a three-team Giga-Egg competition, available daily 18:00–24:00 after the update. Entry requires character level 50 and Rising Egg Scout rank. Twining with the Giga-Egg builds activation. Reaching 100%, or holding Twine when the match ends, determines the winning team. Before queueing — editorial check

Confirm the selected queue, character level, rank and displayed opening time. Read its reward and loadout panel, agree how to contest Twine ownership, and check settlement afterward. November fixes: identify the symptom and queue

The official rolling notice now includes fixes for flight-related midair trapping on November 6, abnormal wind effects on the Giga-Egg on November 4, and Blink Chip movement plus missing Chaos Lost Sanctum Egg Nests on November 2. These are separate developer repair claims, not a new universal extraction rule or an independently tested route. The table keeps their dates and scope separate.
If movement or an egg interaction still fails — editorial checklist

Update through the official client before entering. Record the exact queue and difficulty, client build, platform, server, local time, current Aniimo or egg, equipped chip and action immediately before failure. Distinguish a player stuck while flying, an egg moved by wind, a chip activation with no movement and a nest that failed to appear. A short redacted clip can show these differences better than a generic lag report.
Do not use a bug report as a loss-protection rule

A dated repair does not guarantee an item refund, safe extraction, permanent disconnect protection or a successful retest on your device. Do not deliberately disconnect, spend additional tickets or repeatedly use valuable items merely to reproduce an issue. If it recurs, send the build and sequence through official support; do not install a movement mod or share account credentials.
What Egg Heist is

Operation: Egg Heist is a Lost Isles PvEvP extraction activity built around searching for eggs and supplies, handling Alpha Aniimo or rival Pathfinders, and leaving under the mode's extraction conditions. Older beta rules are retained below only when they help explain the mode's history.
Chaos Mode access in version 1.1

Chaos Mode opened September 24 at 04:00 in each listed regional server time. The official requirement is Tier IV Elite Egg Seeker, and each entry consumes a Chaos Ticket. This replaces the site's earlier statement that access details were unpublished.
Official Chaos Mode reward boundary

The update confirms higher drop rates for Prismana Aniimo Eggs and Prismatic-quality Collectibles, plus a chance at extremely rare Secret Collectibles. It does not publish exact percentages, ticket shop prices, map routes, or a guarantee that any one run produces a specific egg.
Risk and team recommendation

The official notice calls Chaos Mode the highest difficulty, warns that it has strict extraction conditions, and recommends entering with a team. That supports preparation and coordination advice, but not unverified claims about an optimal route, build, or guaranteed strategy.
Holographic Co-op Battle is separate

Version 1.1 also adds a four-player-or-AI Holographic Co-op Battle on a weekly Thursday-to-Monday schedule. It uses three routes, pre-battle team and buff choices, best-star records, weekly rewards and assistance rewards; it should not be confused with Egg Heist's extraction loop.

What still needs public-build evidence

Exact extraction objectives, ticket acquisition and pricing, loss rules, matchmaking behavior, map layouts, egg tables and drop rates require a current official notice or reproducible versioned testing. Competitor route and tier claims are useful research leads, not evidence for this guide.
Read later adjustments separately from the 1.1 launch

Checked October 23, 2026. The rolling official notice records later changes by date, and the weekly notice covers the October 15 resource update. The table below is a change record, not a complete current loot table. A change to one difficulty or trigger does not establish the same change in every queue.
Drop rates and extra spawns are different measures

An Egg Nest spawn chance, a chest drop rate and extra Aniimo triggered by match events describe different systems. Aniimo.GG does not translate the October extra-spawn reduction into a lower rare-egg probability, a safer extraction guarantee or a per-run profit estimate. None of these notices supplies numerical percentages.
Before entering — editorial checklist

Confirm the client resources, selected difficulty, entry cost and extraction conditions shown in the current menu. Check backpack capacity before moving gear, agree on the extraction goal with teammates, and avoid committing irreplaceable resources based on a copied route or an old protection allowance. Record the mode and build when comparing outcomes.
If a fixed inventory or key-door issue returns

Treat a dated fix as evidence of a past change, not proof that your current incident is impossible. Record server, platform, client resources, difficulty, item or key name, inventory space, time and the action immediately before failure. Submit a redacted report through official support; do not repeatedly consume keys to diagnose the door or assume an automatic refund.

extraBody: Roles describe jobs, not a required five-member template

The official index labels DPS, HEAL, SUPPORT, BREAK and REGEN, but a team cannot be judged by badges alone. Version 1.0 community records describe a practical core of damage, controlled BREAK and sustain, with the remaining slot chosen for the current encounter. This is a planning framework, not an official mandatory composition.
Solo and team combat use rosters differently

A version 1.0 combat record distinguishes solo combat, where players can switch among the roster, from team activities where supporting slots may enter through their configured core skills. Before copying a rotation, confirm the mode, active slot and whether each support actually has a usable core skill.
BREAK is a timing window

Community public-build records describe BREAK as pressure on a target gauge followed by a short opening. Prepare the DPS member's EP, position and relevant buffs before triggering it; opening BREAK while the carry is empty or unavailable wastes the opportunity. The official public site does not publish one universal BREAK multiplier.
REGEN and HEAL solve different failures

REGEN helps the team repeat skills by supporting EP flow, while HEAL protects combat uptime. A roster that survives but cannot complete a rotation may need REGEN; one that loses time dodging or reviving may need HEAL. Read each live skill rather than treating the role label as the full effect.
Match the skill, not only the creature badge

Community version 1.0 records warn that the element used by a move and the current form can matter to the matchup. Check the actual equipped skill, target form and support condition before assuming the species label creates an advantage.
A safe combat diagnosis

Change one variable at a time: verify target form and element, confirm the DPS skill element, watch whether BREAK opens on command, check EP at the opening, then test whether Support and sustain effects overlap the intended window. Only after the rotation works should permanent upgrades be blamed.
extraFaq: Do I need one Aniimo from every role?
No official rule requires all five role labels in one team. Cover damage, BREAK and sustain first, then use the remaining space for the encounter and current skills.
What should I prepare before BREAK?
Have the intended DPS ready with enough EP, correct position and relevant buffs. Version 1.0 records treat BREAK as a planned handoff, not a button to trigger immediately.
Are REGEN and HEAL interchangeable?
No. Their role labels point to different jobs: REGEN supports repeatable skill use, while HEAL restores health and protects uptime. Individual skills still decide the exact effect.
Does an Aniimo's listed element determine every attack?
Not necessarily. Community public-build records say to check the element on the equipped move and the target's current form before judging the matchup.
Are published damage multipliers official?
The official Wiki confirms labels but does not publish a complete numerical chart. Treat extracted-client multipliers as versioned community evidence, not permanent official rules.

The November 4 section of the official Known Issues & Fixes notice reports fixing some buttons missing from the Aniimo evolution screen. This is a developer statement about the interface, not a promise that every evolution is eligible, that requirements were removed or that every device has been independently retested.
Choose the branch of the problem before spending

Aniimo.GG recommends separating an absent control from a visible but unavailable action. First record the current build and a screenshot, install the current official update, restart the client and reopen the same Aniimo and destination. If the control is visible, read the unfinished requirement rather than buying materials speculatively. If controls remain absent, report the exact screen; do not release the Aniimo, change account links or repeat a paid action to diagnose it.
What to send if the screen still fails

Include platform/store, client build, server, exact Aniimo and form, selected evolution destination, input device and a redacted screenshot showing whether the controls or requirement text are missing. Record what changed after updating. Never include passwords or one-time codes. These are editorial reporting recommendations, not a tested recovery procedure or a guarantee of item refunds.
Do Aniimo evolve? Yes, but conditions vary

The official Wiki uses Lumin, Gamma and Nova stages. Official beta examples include levels, branching choices, bonding interactions and location objectives, so not every Aniimo should be assumed to evolve at one fixed level.
Official stages
Evolution lines can contain several numbered entries or more than one Nova outcome, so stage and species ID must be tracked separately.
Branching evolution and player choice

Intel 13th/14th-Gen stability notice

Pawprint Studio reports that some desktop PCs with affected 13th- or 14th-Gen Intel Core processors may crash, freeze, show graphical errors, report out-of-VRAM, or blue-screen when using outdated microcode. This is a processor stability notice, not a claim that every Intel system is affected.

Follow Intel’s or your motherboard maker’s BIOS instructions, update to the latest BIOS, and use Intel microcode 0x12B or later as the official notice recommends. body: The base game is free
Official Steam and PlayStation listings describe Aniimo as free to play and disclose optional in-game purchases. A paid pack is not required to download the base client.
Why players still ask whether Aniimo is gacha

The final Beta used Rift Exploration for a low-chance Legendary encounter, so older articles and videos may call the game gacha. Pawprint Studio says the launch version removed repeated chance-based Irisalis attempts and replaced them with Legendary Tokens earned through exploration and story progress.
What the official launch route guarantees

Collect Legendary Tokens, craft a personal Legendary Aniipod, unlock the exclusive encounter, defeat Irisalis and use that Aniipod to seal the bond. Version 1.1 also adds a weekly-limited Iris Petal source and a separately crafted seasonal Aniipod with a stated 100% capture rate.
What the live shop appears to sell

A post-launch PC Gamer review records fixed-price cosmetics bought with Lumin Crystals and bundles containing items or currencies, with no character or equipment banner observed. This is an independent live-client observation, not a permanent promise about every future shop update.
Free does not mean every purchase is cosmetic

Official stores only confirm optional purchases; they do not classify the complete catalogue. Treat cosmetics, convenience items, materials, passes and limited bundles separately, and read the displayed contents and probability disclosure before paying.
A safe spending checklist

Ignore Beta price sheets, confirm the server and platform account, compare the exact bundle contents with earnable alternatives, check expiry and refund wording, and never buy through an unofficial top-up site.
What remains unconfirmed

Pawprint Studio has not made a universal promise that every future Aniimo or progression item will always avoid randomized acquisition. This page describes the current official Irisalis route and documented launch shop, not an irreversible lifetime guarantee.

The official Known Issues & Fixes notice lists a limited-time Companion Handbook EXP boost while the Handbook is below level 70. It does not state a numerical multiplier, ending date or paid-tier requirement. Do not read this as a Pathfinder-level boost, an automatic reward unlock or a reason to purchase.
Regional starts are not one simultaneous unlock

The same official notice lists a mobile gifting failure involving Monthly Pass / Companion Handbook purchases: content may go to the character currently in use instead of the friend. Aniimo.GG advises checking the latest notice before gifting and not repeating a charge to test whether it works. If affected, retain the order reference, platform, server, intended recipient and actual result; contact official support without publishing payment details.
A Handbook decision workflow — editorial advice

Read the active version, Handbook level, edition, unclaimed rewards and remaining event period separately. Inspect any unused redemption item before paying again. The official launch FAQ says a redemption activates the current version, only one paid tier is active per period, and Advanced-to-Collector upgrade requires payment. A boost announcement does not promise every reward before the season ends.
Separate currency by purpose before spending

Use four practical buckets: broad account currency, premium-facing currency, activity-specific tokens and time-gated reward resources. Do not compare two currencies only by the number shown; compare how each is earned, what permanent goals it unlocks and whether it expires or resets.
Use a five-question purchase test

Before any exchange, ask whether the stock is limited, whether normal play can farm the item, whether it removes a current bottleneck, whether the conversion is reversible, and what else uses the same currency. A high rarity label or purchase limit does not make an offer valuable by itself.
Protect flexible currency from replaceable purchases

Credits and common materials may be needed across many systems, while Glimmer and premium-facing resources can have fewer replacement routes. Name the exact upgrade, capture, Homeland or social goal first; keep a reserve when an offer only saves routine play and does not finish that goal.
Official payment rules to check

The official FAQ says console purchases use the platform stores or in-game portal and also identifies the official Aniimo Shop. It describes Lumin Crystal purchase bonuses and states that only one paid Companion Handbook tier can be active per version. Check the current regional store, linked email, server, renewal terms and reward period before paying.
Keep live-client values versioned

Community public-build guides document many vendors, prices, caps and reset windows, but those are useful comparison leads rather than permanent official facts. Capture the client version, shop name, currency, stock limit and reset timer whenever publishing a recommendation.

prismana-rare-forms.h1: Aniimo Prismana and Rare Forms Guide
evidence: Pawprint Studio confirms a flat base chance for every Nurturing attempt, a retained guarantee, Lucky Strikes that can trigger Prismana Flow, and Umbral encounters from Wild Surges.
body: Start with the terms, because they are not synonyms

Prismana is a rare form tied to a Prismana environment. Sparkling is a separate appearance mutation. Umbral is a wild state with Perfect Potential according to versioned client text. Umbrabow is a separate collection and egg label. Alpha describes a dangerous encounter, while Perfect describes potential—not a colour form.
The official Nurturing change

For launch, Pawprint Studio removed the early-game probability decay caused by low Prismatic Energy: every Nurturing attempt now has the same base chance to trigger Prismana Flow, while the guarantee remains. Ecosystem Nurturing grants a fixed amount of Prismatic Energy and offering quality no longer changes Wild Surge quality.
Lucky Strikes and Wild Surges

Lucky Strikes can grant items, raise an area's Prismatic Energy and directly trigger Prismana Flow. Wild Surges can also produce Umbral Aniimo with Perfect Potential and distinctive colour. The official letter does not publish exact percentages.
Three source-labelled Prismana routes

Official material confirms Prismana Flow and Prismana eggs, while versioned public-client records describe Nurturing as the repeatable route that builds regional Prismatic Energy. Homeland RV dispatches can produce eggs with a Prismana trait. Exact species pools and regional requirements must be checked in the live client.
Prismana is not automatically stronger

A rare form can have a different record, element or kit, but the word Prismana alone does not prove higher Potential or universal superiority. Compare the exact form entry. Sparkling and Perfect Potential are separate properties.
Umbral and Umbrabow are different

Versioned client terminology defines Umbral as a state whose distinctive appearance disappears after evolution or transformation. Umbrabow has its own collection labels and Lost Isles egg references. The precise relationship between Umbrabow and hidden Sparkling types is not officially explained, so this guide does not merge them.
A safe rare-hunting loop

Choose a target from the current form record, confirm its region and condition, build the area's collection progress, use the live Nurturing screen, watch Prismatic Energy and Flow indicators, prepare Aniipods before the spawn, and record the client version. Do not spend a premium capture item merely because two rarity terms look similar.
What this page deliberately does not claim

No unofficial exact odds, universal spawn coordinates, RV-level rewards or complete species count are presented as official. These values can be client-derived, event-specific or changed by updates; the current game UI and official probability disclosure take priority.
Read the preview as dated evidence

The October 16 preview preceded the October 29 update. Its dates remain an archived announcement, not a statement that Part 2 is still unreleased. Consult the October 27 update and current game screens for eligibility and claims.
Whisperwake Isles entry and the fallback route

The preview lists Lv. 55, Grade I Trailblazer and completion of A Tale of Tide and Song for the new area. It also says season-exclusive Prismana will be available in Breezy Plains: players without the new-area requirements can nurture the listed Breezy Plains areas during Vein Abundance. This is not a promise that every new island form appears in every old region.
Prepare by route — editorial checklist

Select one target, distinguish ecosystem nurturing from Handbook or achievement rewards, and check the current event panel after the update. For a season-exclusive target, read its weekly area before spending resources. For Hypnyto, inspect the actual Handbook reward tier and activation terms; the preview alone does not state a price. For Ekrim, confirm the live achievement milestone. Keep a record of server, build, target form and displayed requirements.
Verified Wiki forms: Hypnyto is not one element label

Checked October 31, 2026: the official Hypnyto Basic Form page lists Wind and DPS; its Prismana Form page lists Light / Wind and DPS. Both use No.10006 in the Season 1 Keepsakes group. A base-form index badge therefore does not describe every form, and a new element label alone does not prove a universal damage bonus.
Ekrim: Basic and Prismana records are now public

Checked November 6: the official index lists Basic Ekrim in Whisperwake Isles with Dark / BREAK, and a separately linked Prismana Ekrim in Season 1 Keepsakes with Dark / Fire / BREAK. The October 31 Basic-only selector observation is historical, not evidence that another form is absent. Wiki publication still does not verify your Season Achievement milestone or claim status.
A form-first comparison workflow

Open the correct number and group, select the named form, compare its current element and role labels, then verify the acquisition screen in the game. A public Wiki form page confirms a published record, not a capture location, current Handbook tier, price, reward-claim status or guarantee. Do not invent a form URL when the official selector does not link one.

catching-twine.title: Aniimo Catching & Twine System Explained
catching-twine.description: A release-safe Aniimo catching and Twine guide: the confirmed workflow, Beta-only tips, common mistakes, Aniipods, traps and transformation.
body: How catching works
Official descriptions say Pathfinders catch Aniimo with Aniipods, can set traps, and need to time the catch. Exact capture-rate formulas and item modifiers should be verified in the release build.
The release-safe catching workflow

Start by observing the environment and encounter conditions, prepare a trap only when it is useful, aim an Aniipod, then time the catch. After an Aniimo joins your collection, Twine is the separate step that lets you use its form and abilities. The diagram below shows this confirmed order, not a capture-rate estimate.
Beta tips are not launch guarantees

The closed-beta handbook suggested approaching stealthily, targeting sleeping Aniimo, applying Break damage, using higher-tier Aniipods, and raising Researcher Level for capture-related skills. These are useful items to retest, but the September launch letter confirms catching changes, so none should be presented as a final modifier or percentage until the public build is checked.
Common catching mistakes

Do not treat one failed throw as evidence of a fixed rate, copy old beta resource costs, assume every wild encounter has the same conditions, or confuse catching with Twine. Record the game version, weather, time, phenomenon, Aniipod used and result before publishing a location or catch tip.
Irisalis has a redesigned legendary encounter

For launch, exploration and story progress award legendary tokens used to craft a personal Legendary Aniipod. Crafting it unlocks Irisalis's exclusive map encounter, described as a one-time battle and catch sequence.
Prismana, Lucky Strikes and Umbral encounters

Nurturing now has a flat base chance to trigger Prismana Flow while keeping its guarantee. Lucky Strikes can award items, add Prismatic Energy and directly trigger Prismana Flow. Wild Surges can produce Umbral Aniimo with Perfect Potential and distinctive coloration; exact rates remain unpublished.
Spawns respond to the world
Aniimo can appear according to environment, weather, phenomena, and time of day. A useful location guide therefore needs more than a single coordinate: it should record conditions and version.
What Twine means
Twine lets a Pathfinder become a collected Aniimo and use that creature's skills and perspective. It supports combat, puzzle solving, traversal, and environmental challenges.
Traversal examples

Official material specifically shows gliding, diving, and burrowing. Individual official Wiki entries also list mobility or pathfinding abilities, such as Emberpup's faster movement and Nimbi's aerial dash.
What still needs versioned testing

Exact capture modifiers, trap behavior, resource costs, stamina, cooldowns and multiplayer ownership require versioned evidence. Unverified values are not presented as confirmed just because launch has passed.

extraBody: Check Aniimo Distribution before chasing a coordinate

A version-labelled public-build 1.0 community walkthrough records Aniimo Distribution in the map view as the first practical check: use it to review regional collection progress and the current weather before travelling. A greyed-out entry can mean the relevant area is not unlocked, so it is not proof that the Aniimo is absent from the game. This interface workflow is community-observed, not an official spawn table.
Use a four-condition spawn checklist

Confirm the exact Aniimo or form, the region or habitat, the current weather, and the time or active phenomenon before searching. Prismatic Energy is a separate condition for Prismana-related activity. A matching coordinate without matching conditions is not a reproducible sighting.
Terrain is not the same as active weather

Snow on the ground does not by itself confirm that the current weather state is Snowy, and a form name does not prove its live spawn condition. Read the in-game weather or distribution indicator and visually confirm the target form before spending a rare Aniipod.
Record sightings so another player can repeat them

For a useful report, save the client version, server or region, exact form, broad area, displayed weather, time of day, active phenomenon and the before-and-after result. Treat third-party maps as leads rather than guarantees: patches, unlock state and world conditions can all change the outcome.
Keep ordinary weather spawns separate from Prismana Flow

Rain, snow and time-of-day checks describe world spawn conditions. Prismana Flow, Prismatic Energy, Lucky Strikes and season-exclusive Prismana rules are a different system described in the official September developer letter and later event notices. Use the dedicated Prismana guide for that workflow.
extraFaq: Why is the target missing at a listed location?
Check unlock progress, the exact form, current weather, time and active phenomena. A coordinate alone is not a complete spawn condition.
Where should I check the current weather and distribution?

A public-build 1.0 community walkthrough records Aniimo Distribution in the map view as the practical place to review regional progress and weather. Interface labels may change, so verify them in your current client.
Does snowy terrain guarantee a Snowy spawn?
No. Terrain appearance and the active weather state should be checked separately, and the exact form should be confirmed before capture.
Are third-party spawn coordinates guaranteed?
No. They are useful leads, but version, unlock state, weather, time and phenomena can make the result different.
Is Prismana Flow the same as ordinary rain or snow?
No. Prismana Flow and Prismatic Energy belong to the Prismana system; ordinary weather and time are world spawn conditions.

multiplayer.title: Aniimo Multiplayer Guide: Holo-Battle, Crossplay & Egg Heist
multiplayer.description: Aniimo multiplayer and Affinity guide: distinguish creature Affinity from friendship gates, review official earning routes and limits, then check co-op, voice and Companion Mode safely.
multiplayer.h1: Aniimo Multiplayer, Holo-Battle and Egg Heist
body: Two Affinity systems: individual Aniimo versus a friend

The November 9 official notice for the November 12 update describes Aniimo Affinity attached to an individual creature. Older public-build 1.0 community records instead describe your relationship with another Pathfinder as a gate for Exchange and Companion Mode gifts. A shared English label does not make these the same meter; inspect which individual or friend the current panel identifies.
What the official Aniimo Affinity notice says

Increasing an Aniimo’s Affinity unlocks renaming and increases the effects of Heal and Swoleshroom on that Aniimo. The notice lists gradual gain while in your Party or Home, Star Up and Ascend, completing Pathfinder Challenges or Egg Heist with it, and defeating wild Aniimo or Alphas with it. Each Aniimo has daily and weekly gain limits; no numerical cap, required level, gain rate or rename cost is provided here.
Check progress without speculative spending — editorial advice

Record the selected individual and its Affinity before an ordinary eligible activity, then compare the same individual afterward and inspect any daily/weekly limit display. A missing gain is not proof of a bug or a particular cap. Do not buy friend gifts or spend training materials solely because you assume they are required for the creature’s rename unlock. Ask official support if the current panel differs; we have not independently measured gains or renamed an Aniimo.
Announcement scope is not a maintenance-completion claim

This section summarizes the dated official update notice, not a live server-health or successful-login test. Use the current client to verify feature availability. The announcement does not establish that creature Affinity carries through Inherit or Exchange, or that old friend-tier numbers apply to it.
Does Aniimo have multiplayer and crossplay?

Yes. Steam lists single-player, online co-op, online PvP and cross-platform multiplayer. The official account FAQ says progress is shared across platforms on the same server, while different servers keep separate progress.
Holo-Battle Interlink is the current four-player co-op mode

The official version 1.1 notice says players can form a four-player team or match with AI teammates. It opens at Trailblazer I and runs Thursday through Monday according to each server's listed time zone.
Three routes, stars and team-leader decisions

Holo-Battle has three challenge routes. Players choose a team and starting buff; after each win the Team Leader selects one of two buffs for the group. Highest stars and weekly rewards make role coverage and communication more useful than one universal team.
Egg Heist counts belong to a specific description

An earlier official Egg Heist description uses a three-player team. Do not apply that number to every later queue or infer a campaign limit from it. Check the dedicated Egg Heist guide and the selected mode’s current rules; Chaos has its own entry requirements.
Companion Mode and trading: versioned community help

A version 1.0 in-game-help record documents friends, Affinity, Aniimo Exchange and Companion Mode. These details explain how players meet and travel together, but every trading limit remains subject to the current client.
Story and host-world boundaries still need care

Official pages do not fully define guest main-story credit, permanent travel unlocks, shared catching ownership or every host-world rule. Activity-specific group sizes do not prove the full campaign supports the same size.
What same-server progress does and does not answer
Same-server progress does not confirm cross-server transfer, shared purchases or every friend and voice-chat limit. Check the dedicated Crossplay guide before changing platform or server.
Party voice starts with an opt-in setting

The September 30 official change disabled team voice by default. Enable it under Sound Settings > Voice Settings if you want to use it. Aniimo.GG recommends agreeing with teammates first, then checking input, output and any push-to-talk binding in your current client; an old PC shortcut is not a universal console or mobile instruction.
Check resources before diagnosing Holo-Battle

The October 14 official fix addresses abnormal Alpha AI in Holo-Battle Interlink Cycles 4 and 5 and asks players to update game resources before entering. This dated fix is not proof that every AI, matchmaking or connection failure has the same cause.
Separate Companion Mode report mail from gifting

The October 10 notice records a fix for friends not receiving mail after reporting in Companion Mode. Community version 1.0 help describes shared report rewards, but that flow is separate from Aniimo Exchange and catch gifting. Inspect the recipient's mail and the report result; the notice does not promise retroactive delivery for every missing reward.
A low-risk session check and support record

Our recommended order is to confirm the server and activity, finish available client/resource updates, agree on voice use, then check one ordinary report and the intended recipient's mail. If it still fails, note the server, platform, build, local time with time zone, mode and steps, plus redacted before/after screenshots. Use official support rather than repeating paid gifts, sharing credentials or changing servers as a blind fix.

faq: Does friend Affinity unlock an Aniimo’s nickname?
The official new feature concerns the individual Aniimo. Do not infer its rename requirement from an older friend-tier table.
What are the daily and weekly Aniimo Affinity caps?
The official notice confirms limits per Aniimo but does not give their values. Check the current individual’s panel rather than copying a friend-system cap.
Should I buy gifts to raise creature Affinity?
The notice lists Party/Home, training and named activities; it does not identify friend gifts as a requirement. Verify the correct meter before spending.
How many players are in Holo-Battle Interlink?
The official version 1.1 notice says four players can form a team, with AI matchmaking also available.
When is Holo-Battle Interlink open?
The official schedule runs Thursday through Monday using server-local time zones. Check the live event panel for the exact window.
How many players are in Egg Heist?
It depends on the queue. The earlier official description names a three-player team, not a universal player count for every later Egg Heist mode.
Is Aniimo crossplay or cross-save?
The official FAQ says progress is shared across platforms on the same server; different servers remain separate.
Can I play Aniimo solo?
Yes. Single-player is listed, and Holo-Battle offers AI teammates; other multiplayer activities can have different solo rules.
Why can I not hear my party?

The official September 30 change turned team voice off by default. Check Sound Settings > Voice Settings first; then inspect your current input/output and binding settings. This is not evidence that crossplay itself is broken.
Is missing Companion Mode report mail a failed Aniimo trade?
No. Report rewards, Aniimo Exchange and catch gifting are different flows. The October 10 official mail fix does not establish a refund, compensation or retroactive-delivery rule.
Does updating resources fix every multiplayer problem?
No. The October 14 instruction specifically concerns Alpha AI in Holo-Battle Interlink Cycles 4 and 5. Unrelated network or account problems need their own diagnosis.
extraBody: Friend Affinity gates — versioned community evidence

Public-build 1.0 community records describe Affinity with a friend unlocking Exchange, Companion Mode gifting and gestures. This is the friend relationship, not the individual Aniimo feature announced for November 12. Read current Friends-profile limits and costs; old thresholds are not permanent official rules.
Use the correct transfer route

Aniimo Exchange starts from a friend relationship and involves both players reviewing an offered Aniimo. Companion Mode gifting is a separate route for an eligible catch made during the group session. Do not assume an exchange rule, limit or form list automatically applies to a Companion Mode gift.
Inspect identity before accepting

Check the exact species and form, Potential distribution, personality, rarity, training investment and any lock shown by the current client. A matching portrait does not prove that the offered copy is the one discussed. Both players should compare the final preview before confirming.
A safe friend-session workflow

Add the Pathfinder through the current Friends interface, play together until the relevant Affinity feature is visibly unlocked, choose Exchange or Companion Mode gifting intentionally, remove an Aniimo from unavailable assignments if the client requires it, compare both sides, then record the client version and result. Never pay another player real money or share an account for a trade.
extraFaq: Can you exchange Aniimo with strangers?
Version 1.0 community records describe Aniimo Exchange as a friend feature, not an anonymous market. Verify the current Friends profile before planning a transfer.
Are trade limits and costs permanent?
No. They are live-client values and can change. This guide deliberately does not convert third-party numbers into permanent official rules.
Is Companion Mode gifting the same as Aniimo Exchange?
No. Community client records describe them as separate routes with different context and eligibility checks.
What should I verify before accepting?
Check exact form, Potential, personality, rarity, training, restrictions and the final preview on both accounts.
Can I buy an Aniimo from another player for real money?
Do not use real-money or account-sharing arrangements. They create fraud, account and terms-of-service risks outside the in-game workflow.

evidence: The launch version adds a multi-area Home map, house building, furniture share codes, interactive furniture, improved Home Aniimo behavior, petting, discounted furniture resale, Prismana-trait eggs from RV dispatches and shared harvests from social tilling.
body: Homeland, Home and RV are related but different

The official developer letter confirms a multi-area Home map, house building, furniture share codes, interactive furniture and improved resident Aniimo behavior. Community public-build records use Homeland for the overall housing-production system, Home for the build space and RV for the mobile entrance and progression hub. Current client wording takes priority.
Start with the live tutorial, not a copied cost table

Community guides agree that Fannie and an RV quest introduce the system, but disagree on the consolidated unlock path and some limits. Follow the current quest log and RV menu; Aniimo.GG does not turn a disputed level, cap or cost into an official rule.
The safe production loop

A versioned public-build record describes the loop: place farmland or a facility, select a product, read its Ability Distribution, assign Aniimo that cover every required job, keep workers fed, and move output to storage. Cover missing jobs before chasing higher worker levels.
What the official launch changes confirm

Pawprint Studio confirms adjusted RV upgrade times, improved order refreshes, discounted furniture resale through the Co-op Store, RV dispatches that can produce Prismana-trait eggs, seasonal furniture and formulas, social tilling with shared harvests, and more responsive Home Aniimo interactions.
Friends and eggs in Home

Official material supports meeting other Pathfinders around RV camps and sharing harvests. Community public-build help also records visiting, soil help and Hatchinator assistance. Exact daily limits and time reductions must be checked in the live client.
The six officially named Idyll regions

The official site names Forest of Falling Stars, Mistwoods, Echoback Landing, Sea of Flowers, Blitzwood and Nimbus Fields. Homeland progression is separate from this field-region index; raising the RV does not itself unlock every region, spawn or story gate.
Map and farming claims need versions

The map page avoids unverified coordinates, resource nodes and spawn routes. Likewise, Homeland profit tables, crop yields, worker caps and refresh values should carry a client version and reproducible evidence before being treated as current.
A safe first-session checklist

Complete the live RV introduction, learn manual planting and collection, read each formula's required jobs, preserve enough combat Aniimo for the field team, stock worker food, collect output before it blocks production, and delay expensive layout optimization until the RV menu shows the real requirements.
