extraBody: October Home Season boost: confirmed scope

The October 16 notice reports a resource update released October 15 without downtime; restart the client. Moondew Radish and Waxing Moon Pepper gain higher mutation chances, and products crafted with them award more Harvest Moon Points. No percentage, multiplier or boost end date is supplied.
Harvest Gathering: opening time, not a deadline

Stage 3 opens on 2026-10-20 at 20:00 UTC+0 in Europe and 16:00 UTC-4 in the Americas; APAC opens on 2026-10-21 at 04:00 UTC+8 (Beijing). These are the same instant: 2026-10-20T20:00:00Z, or October 21 at 05:00 JST. Hosting and participating are both reward routes. This is not a published claim deadline.
Preparation checklist — editorial advice

Inspect the live event panel and both crop recipes. Check ingredients, required jobs, worker food and storage; reserve progression materials before changing production. Once open, compare hosting and participation requirements rather than assuming hosting is mandatory. If entry fails, record the server, resource version and displayed conditions.
Controller selection and spending

The update adds Select All to controller-based batch acceleration at Home facilities. Recheck selected facilities and the displayed cost before confirming. Improved controls do not imply free acceleration, unlimited uses or an optimal farming layout.
Hatchinator: from an egg to a claimed companion

A public-build 1.0 community record places Hatchinators at Outposts, Astra and Homeland. Read the egg's own use text, select a supported machine and an available slot, then check the displayed incubation timer. Interface steps can change; follow the current client prompt.
A finished timer still needs a claim

An illustrated third-party walkthrough distinguishes incubation from the reveal and Claim interaction. If an egg seems stuck after its timer ends, return to the occupied slot and complete the current hatch prompts. Before confirming a requested Aniipod, read its hatch-specific description rather than assuming wild-catch effects apply.
Read the egg promise before planning a result

An egg's element, form, trait and Potential labels describe different properties. Aniimo.GG recommends recording the exact item name and explicit guarantee before incubation, then comparing the claimed result. Missing outcome data does not prove an empty pool, and an unpublished rate cannot be inferred from one hatch.
Sources, help and a useful hatch record

The official developer letter confirms RV dispatches can produce eggs with the Prismana trait. Community 1.0 help records exploration eggs and friends assisting a Homeland Hatchinator. Check live eligibility and timers before planning assistance. For troubleshooting, record the client version, exact egg, machine, timer, warning text and claim result; do not publish a universal duration or probability from one result.

extraBody: Do not confuse an elemental obstacle with a damage check

Community public-build 1.0 help describes Fire clearing combustible obstacles, Water interacting with marked flames or plants, Ice creating temporary water platforms and Lightning charging devices. Read the object's current prompt and observe its reaction before spending combat upgrades; not every decorative object supports an interaction.
Check Element Level and Material Level

If a marked object barely reacts, inspect its indicator and the selected ability's text. Use the correct actor for object movement

Gravity Pull is recorded as a Pathfinder tool for marked ancient objects. Repeatedly changing Aniimo may not solve an interaction that expects a Pathfinder action. Check the live action label, equipped tool and target; use the corresponding tutorial before trying the room again.
A repeatable puzzle troubleshooting loop

Aniimo.GG recommends reading the prompt, selecting one matching tool, changing one state and checking the result. For a circuit, follow the visible connection rather than attacking every object; for a perspective clue, check camera alignment. Record version, room, active form, tool, indicator and reaction if the expected change does not occur.

Should I raise combat level to solve every obstacle?

When should I use Gravity Pull?

What should I record for a stuck mechanism?

beginner-mistakes.h1: Aniimo Beginner Mistakes to Avoid in the Live Game
evidence: Account shortcuts can cause permanent loss

Pawprint Studio prohibits cheats, auto-catch scripts, virtual multi-instance tools, client modifications, bug exploitation, account trading or sharing, unauthorized asset sales and third-party top-ups.
body: Do not follow Beta instructions in the live game

Old routes, prices, catch modifiers, keybinds and rewards can be wrong. Record the current client version, read the live tutorial and menu, and treat an undated screenshot or copied table as a lead—not an instruction.
Do not choose the wrong server and assume everything transfers

The official mobile FAQ says progress is shared across platforms only within the same server; different servers keep independent data. Confirm account and server before creating a long-term character or paying. The FAQ does not promise that every purchase, friend list or server can be transferred.
Do not spend a premium Aniipod on an unverified target

Community public-build guides agree on protecting scarce high-grade capture items, but exact item effects and sources can change. Read the current item tooltip, target form and displayed catch information before throwing; keep ordinary supplies equipped for routine catches.
Do not build only for damage or a tier-list rank

The official index separates DPS, Heal, Support, Break and Regen. Community live guides consistently flag missing BREAK and narrow element coverage as early friction. Start with complementary jobs and elements, then replace members when the current encounter proves a gap.
Do not invest every material in the first catch

Evolution, Resonance, Capability Awakening and carried-item choices are different investments. The official launch letter confirms easier resets below level 60 and Capafruit inheritance, but that does not make every resource refundable. Test a small core before broad spending.
Do not treat non-combat Aniimo as useless

A lower-priority fighter may still add a traversal interaction, collection entry or Homeland job. Check the form, mobility and Ability Distribution before releasing the only copy or assigning every useful worker to combat.
Do not leave Homeland production blocked

Community public-build records describe workers, food, output storage and job coverage as one loop. Read each formula's Ability Distribution, cover every required job, collect output before capacity blocks the next cycle and preserve a field team.
Never trade accounts, exploit bugs or use unofficial top-ups

The official Fair Play notice says account sharing and trading, unauthorized asset transactions, third-party discounted top-ups, cheats, auto-catch scripts, virtual multi-instance tools, client changes and intentional bug exploitation can lead to recovered gains, suspension or permanent bans.
A safe first-week decision loop

Follow the pinned story until a system opens, confirm the live requirement, spend only what the current screen explains, record irreversible choices, and open the dedicated catching, team, Homeland or training guide only when that decision arrives.

team-setup.title: Aniimo Team Building Guide: Roles, Elements & Safe Starter Core
team-setup.description: Build a flexible Aniimo team with the five official role labels and nine-element roster. Includes a practical starter framework without pretending it is an official tier list.
team-setup.h1: How to Build an Aniimo Team
body: Start with official labels, not a copied tier list

The official Compendium currently organizes Aniimo by five role labels—DPS, BREAK, SUPPORT, HEAL and REGEN—and nine elements. Those labels are reliable navigation facts. Exact rankings, universal best teams and damage multipliers are not published as official rules, so this guide keeps editorial recommendations separate from official data.
A safe starter core: damage, Break and sustain

Aniimo.GG recommends beginning with one DPS option, one BREAK option and one sustain option from HEAL or REGEN. This is an editorial resource-saving framework, not an official required formation. It gives early upgrades a clear purpose while leaving room to adapt after you read each Aniimo's live skill page.
Use the flexible slot to answer the encounter

Fill the remaining space with SUPPORT, a second damage option, extra sustain or an element that improves your coverage. Change that choice when an encounter asks for faster breaking, safer recovery, more damage or a different element instead of investing in one permanent team for every activity.
Treat HEAL and REGEN as labels, not identical kits

Both labels point toward sustain, but the role name alone does not prove how quickly, how often or under what conditions an Aniimo restores resources. Read the individual skill text before deciding which one fits your team; do not infer exact mechanics from the filter label.
Build element coverage gradually

The official index exposes nine elements, which makes coverage useful when you expand the roster. It does not establish that beginners must raise one Aniimo of every element immediately. Strengthen a small usable core first, then add alternatives when the live encounter or skill text gives you a concrete reason.
Use the Compendium as the source of truth

Filter the official Compendium by role and element, then compare those entries with Aniimo.GG's bilingual index and each official detail page. Recheck after version updates: roles, skills and balance can change, and an editorial framework should never override current in-game text.
Multiplayer needs a separate decision

The version 1.1 notice says Holo-Battle team leaders choose between buffs after each win. That cooperative rule is activity-specific and does not prove a universal solo roster size or one best composition. Agree on damage, breaking and sustain coverage with the group instead of assuming a solo template applies unchanged.

They are separate official Compendium labels, but the label alone does not define every skill condition or value. Read the current individual skill page before choosing.

extraBody: October 30 fixes: chests, waterfalls and Dewple

Official notice 100275 lists fixes for mobile chests under trees, Waterfall Climb and the mysterious mechanism in The Challenge of Fighting Upstream!, plus Dewple’s Waterfall Form unlock in the Isle of Might. These are dated developer claims, not independent retests.
Elite Training: distinguish task status from input fixes

The notice lists four Holo-Battle Sim required/elective tasks as temporarily unavailable. Its later input-response fix does not explicitly resolve those four tasks. Check the current task and notice before treating them as fixed.
If a listed fix still fails — editorial checklist

Update via the official client, record the build and exact objective, then retry from a safe checkpoint. Send persistent issues to Support with platform, server, timestamp and a redacted screenshot. Do not delete progress or change account links.
Android: Stars and the Knight Journey freeze

Checked October 22, 2026 against the official rolling Known Issues & Fixes notice. For the freeze reported on some Android devices during Stars and the Knight Journey, the developer suggests Performance Mode, disabling Shadows in Settings, or skipping the cutscene with the upper-right button. These are scoped workarounds, not a claim that every Android freeze is fixed.
Boundless Twining rewards after switching from PC

The notice identifies a case where rewards cannot be claimed on mobile immediately after PC login and suggests logging in again. Aniimo.GG recommends verifying the same account and server first, then checking the reward screen after the retry. Do not create a replacement account or relink accounts to test this symptom.
Forest of Butterfly Dreams page indoors

For event-page display issues in indoor locations such as ChillBeanz, the official notice suggests leaving the current area and trying again. This does not establish a fix for every blank screen or the separately listed unexpected blocks in mobile Home.
If the workaround fails — editorial escalation

Record the exact quest or event, device and OS, client version, server, local time, screen before failure and the result of each attempted step. Record graphics settings before changing them. Distinguish a workaround from a dated patch fix; neither proves a persistent recurrence has the same cause. Send a redacted report through official support rather than repeating reinstallations or deleting account data.
Use the official support route

The official launch notice directs players to Menu → Support, or F10 for a quick report, and lists support_en@aniimo.com plus the Support Center linked below. If the game cannot open, use the web center or email. Review the current in-game bindings if the shortcut differs.
A specific official advisory for repeated PC crashes

Aniimo's September 14 advisory identifies some 13th- and 14th-generation Intel Core desktop processors and symptoms including repeated crashes, freezes and out-of-VRAM errors. Compare your exact CPU with the official affected-model list. This does not diagnose every crash or mean that an out-of-VRAM message proves the graphics card is at fault.
Follow the hardware vendor for firmware changes

The advisory recommends following Intel or the motherboard manufacturer's guidance for a current BIOS and microcode 0x12B or later. Its tuning steps are hardware-specific. Read the complete notice and current manufacturer instructions, or ask support to confirm applicability before changing firmware or processor settings.
Send a reproducible report

Aniimo.GG recommends this template: platform/store; server; client version; local time and time zone; CPU/GPU and OS; exact error; action immediately before failure; frequency; steps already tried and their result. Attach a redacted screenshot and only the diagnostics official support requests. This makes a persistent local crash distinguishable from a service queue.
extraFaq: Does the November 6 patch fix every laptop stutter?
No such guarantee is stated. The official patch names some laptops only. Update, compare the same activity and report a recurrence with the build and device details.
Does the DLSS fix add Frame Generation to every GPU?
The notice fixes an existing function not working; it does not publish a new compatibility list. Do not infer hardware support or a promised FPS gain from this entry.

No. Match the exact objective. A dated fix claim is not a successful retest on your device or evidence that separately listed tasks were resolved.

No. It is one suggested workaround for the named Stars and the Knight Journey issue on some Android devices, alongside disabling Shadows or skipping the cutscene.
Should I relink my account if mobile event rewards will not claim?
Not for this symptom. The Boundless Twining advisory suggests logging in again after PC-to-mobile switching. Check account and server, then contact support if it persists.
How can I contact Aniimo support if the client will not open?
Use the official Support Center linked from the launch notice or support_en@aniimo.com. Include your platform, version and exact error.
Does every out-of-VRAM error mean my GPU is too weak?
No. Aniimo's Intel CPU advisory includes that symptom among possible processor stability issues. Check the exact hardware and seek a diagnosis.
Should every player change BIOS or CPU settings?
No. The official advisory targets listed desktop processors and repeated instability. Follow current hardware-vendor instructions for your exact model.

launch-troubleshooting.h1: Aniimo Login, Crash and Support Guide
body: November 6 performance fixes: start with the build

Official patch v1.1.3887621.0, dated November 6, 2026, reports a fix for DLSS Frame Generation not working and for stuttering on some laptops. These are developer fix statements, not Aniimo.GG performance measurements. The notice gives no affected laptop list, frame-rate uplift, recommended graphics preset or guarantee that every stutter has the same cause.
Update, compare and report — editorial retest procedure

Before changing settings, record your client build, GPU, laptop model, OS, graphics settings and whether the symptom is a missing frame-generation effect, uneven motion or a crash. Install the current official update, restart the client, and compare the same location and activity under the same settings. Change only one setting at a time if further diagnosis is needed. If the symptom remains, send the before/after build and result through official support; do not replace DLLs, alter firmware or weaken security protection merely because this patch mentions performance.
A separate controller fix is not a graphics fix

The same patch reports a controller radial-menu fix at the Park. Match that exact interface before treating it as resolved; it does not establish support for every controller or fix unrelated input problems. Likewise, the DLSS entry does not announce support for additional GPUs, consoles or mobile devices.
Login queues and slow loading can happen

Pawprint Studio’s live announcement warns that launch demand can cause login queues or slower loading. A queue alone does not confirm an account error or a server outage. Keep the client open only when it is behaving normally, avoid repeated account actions, and check the official Aniimo channels before changing account settings.
Use the official client and the right account

Install only from Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation, Xbox, App Store, Google Play, or links on the official Aniimo website. Sign in with the same recoverable account used for the character you want to continue. PC and mobile share the same data when the same account is used; this does not establish a server-transfer or purchase-sharing rule.
Check the simple causes first

Confirm your connection is stable, close unnecessary background programs, and check that the device meets the official requirements for its platform. On PC, Steam lists Windows 10, 8 GB RAM and 40 GB free storage as the current minimum. Do not use a beta client, APK mirror, modified launcher or account-sharing tool as a workaround.
Record useful details before asking for help

Keep the platform, store, region, local time, game version, device model, operating system, error wording and screenshots of non-sensitive error screens. Never share passwords, one-time codes, recovery email access or payment information in a community post or to an unofficial support account.
When not to guess a fix

Official announcements do not publish every queue cause, error-code meaning, server-status endpoint, account-link workflow, controller setting or performance workaround. Do not reinstall repeatedly, alter firmware, change network security settings or follow unverified social-media fixes unless official support documents the exact step.
Where to check next

Use the server-status page for sourced availability notes, the mobile-launch guide for September 23 mobile availability, and the system-requirements guide for PC compatibility. This page will only add individual fixes after a reproducible public-build report or an official support notice is available.
faq: Why is Aniimo showing a login queue?
The official launch announcement says queues or slower loading may occur because many players are joining. Check official notices before assuming an account problem.
Should I reinstall Aniimo if loading is slow?
Not automatically. First verify the official client, account, connection and current notices. Official sources do not describe reinstalling as a universal queue or loading fix.
What should I include in a support report?
Platform, store, region, local time, game version, device and the exact non-sensitive error wording are useful. Do not share passwords, one-time codes or recovery access.
Can I use an APK or third-party launcher to fix download issues?
No. Use only official stores and the official Aniimo website; unofficial clients can create security and account risks.
Does this page list every error code?
No. It lists only launch guidance supported by official sources. Error-code meanings require an official support notice or repeatable public-build verification.

Continue with the right account and server

Officially confirmed mobile performance notes

Aniimo says the mobile client supports 60 FPS except on a small number of lower-end devices. The PC and console FAQ also confirms Xbox Cloud Gaming through a Microsoft account at xbox.com/play on mobile, tablet, PC and Xbox. Cloud streaming is separate from the native iOS and Android app and does not confirm controller support, latency, regional availability or subscription terms.

editorial-policy.title: Aniimo.GG Editorial, Evidence & Correction Policy
editorial-policy.description: How Aniimo.GG grades official sources, versioned tests and community reports, manages freshness and corrects errors.
body: Source hierarchy

We prefer the current game client and first-party Aniimo notices, Wiki entries and store listings. Repeatable release-build tests come next. Versioned third-party observations may identify a testable lead; anonymous claims, undated screenshots and copied tables are not established facts.
Evidence labels and boundaries

Pages separate official facts, Aniimo.GG advice, release-build observations, community reports and unconfirmed information. An official feature announcement does not prove every value, platform behavior, coordinate, cost or probability associated with it.
Version and freshness management

Events, numbers, drops, shops, capture rates and quest conditions carry a version or review date. Time-sensitive pages are checked against current notices; expired launch, pre-order and event information is retained only when clearly labelled historical.
Testing standard

A release-build result should record platform, server or region when relevant, client version, conditions and repeatable steps. One account result is not converted into a universal rate, guaranteed location or ranking.
Corrections and independence

Confirmed errors are corrected promptly and material guide changes are logged. Beta instructions are not silently carried into the live game. Advertising, advertising applications and source links do not determine conclusions; future sponsored or affiliate relationships must be disclosed beside affected content.
